elements.before: Independent, lender-grade analysis for medical office buildings, ambulatory surgery centers, and dental, veterinary, and physician practices across SBA 7(a) and 504, USDA, conventional bank, CMBS, life-company, and agency capital. This page is our standing read on the one distinction that governs the asset class, the going-concern practice valued on cash flow versus the income-producing medical building valued on net operating income, how each fails review, and the demographic and outpatient tailwind underneath both.
elements.after: Tell us first whether you are financing a practice, a surgery center or a medical office building: the asset class turns on that line. A practice or ASC is an operating business valued on its cash flow; a medical office building is real estate, valued on the net operating income its leases produce. Feasibility Study Company prepares medical office and ASC feasibility studies on the right basis, market study included, for physician owners, developers and their lenders across SBA 7(a) and 504, USDA, banks, CMBS, life companies and agencies. On the real-estate side, triple-net asking rent set a record at $24.86 a square foot in 2024's second quarter,7 and the study tests whether your tenants can carry rent at that level.
